source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 27 April 1905, p. 11 ("District Councils: Lurgan": nominations)
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten divisions, two councillors each), polled 25 May 1905; contests in Lurgan Rural and Tartaraghan only. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Only one candidate was nominated; "one of the retiring members retains office" (not named, not filed).
